blocks.text: Highlights from my opening of the Ignite keynote this morning on how we’re building a frontier ecosystem to turn advances in AI into real-world impact.

Our ambition with everything we are announcing at Ignite today is to parlay technological advances into real outcomes and new points of leverage for people, organizations, and society at large.

Just a few of the things we’re announcing:

Copilot Workspaces. The time has come to move beyond single-player AI to a world where people and their agents work together, with shared context, towards a common goal. That's Copilot Workspaces.

New models. For us, it's about mapping intelligence to a given task, with the best economics. This is something we can uniquely do in the context of real-world tasks by tuning our products, harness, tools, and the model system end to end.

Today, we're announcing Microsoft-Decision 1.1 (now GA), Code 2 (at the cost-performance frontier for enterprise coding), and Cyber 2 Flash (outperforming frontier models on security tasks at a fraction of the cost).

And, of course, we have all the most popular closed and open weight models in Foundry too. We are very excited to bring OpenAI's GPT-6.2 to Foundry.

And we are announcing that Meta's latest models are all coming to Foundry, as well!

Agent 365 Business Analytics. You can think of this as your ERP system for AI, helping organizations connect spend to business value and continuously optimize their return on intelligence.

Microsoft Perception. Now GA, it brings together teams of red, blue, and green agents to deliver security outcomes at machine speed, with you always in control.

Microsoft AI Transparency Initiative. We're working with 40+ organizations to establish open standards for AI that is accountable, independently verifiable, and safe by design.

HorizonDB. Our distributed PostgreSQL database is now GA in Azure, delivering up to 8X the performance of self-managed Postgres.

And by bringing HorizonDB into Fabric, agents will be able to reason over live transactions alongside petabytes of historical data in real time.

Finally, we are also rearchitecting the core compute, storage, and networking primitives in Azure to execute, connect, and share context at agent scale.

Plus, we announced new partnerships and shared work we are doing with customers in every industry sector, including Alaska Airlines, AT&T, BlackRock, BNY, Chevron, Epic, Publicis Groupe, Salesforce, Unilever, and more.

Ultimately, the key imperatives for us are to ensure human ambition, a firm's control of its own intelligence, and trust in technology that gets broadly diffused is maintained.

This is the promise of a frontier ecosystem. Read more: https://lnkd.in/gyGc-7AF

Looking forward to Ignite, kicking off today at 10am PST! Hope you’ll join us live.

We're redefining the SDLC for the agentic era.

Lots of GitHub updates this morning at Universe:

• GitHub Copilot Fusion delivers frontier-level quality, 40% faster and at up to 77% lower cost
• Our unified Copilot harness is now in Foundry, a managed service for building long-running agents that reason, use tools, and get work done
• Copilot Projects gives you an orchestration loop to build with multiple agents across repos

And we’re expanding capacity and strengthening GitHub’s architecture to make the home of agentic development more resilient.

Read more: https://lnkd.in/gvtEeair

Keeping over a million elevators and escalators running smoothly is no small task.

Today in Cologne, I heard about how TK Elevator is using our tech to help provide its service technicians access to decades of shared knowledge, streamlining the process, so they can spend less time searching for answers and more time keeping people moving.

Read more: https://lnkd.in/gEjFzJWC

Today in the UK, I saw how the Yorkshire Ambulance Service NHS Trust is using Copilot to cut down on administrative work and make better use of its data, and ultimately provide a better experience for medical personnel and patients.

It's an early example of what's possible as NHS England expands Copilot to as many as 500,000 clinicians and support staff across the country.

Read more: https://lnkd.in/gj8h5e4Z

Great to meet with the Saint-Gobain team in Paris today and learn how they’re using Microsoft Discovery to help accelerate the development of new more-efficient construction materials.
